description: This file defines a React component named TeamsTable that renders a table of team data, including team details, members, roles, and actions for editing or deleting teams. It uses UI components from external libraries and includes props for handling user interactions.

classes.name: TeamsTableProps
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the properties that the TeamsTable React component expects, including teams data, organization info, user info, and callback functions.

interfaces.name: TeamInfo
interfaces.description: Contains an array of members with roles for a specific team.

interfaces.name: PerTeamInfo
interfaces.description: Aggregates team keys and team info such as members with roles, associated with a specific team ID.
